files.name: keymaps.lua
files.description: Space to lead. Find a file. Keep the change in focus.
files.code:
-- Selected mappings from the configured workflow
vim.g.mapleader = " "
vim.g.maplocalleader = " "

-- Window navigation
vim.keymap.set("n", "<C-h>", "<C-w><C-h>")
vim.keymap.set("n", "<C-j>", "<C-w><C-j>")
vim.keymap.set("n", "<C-k>", "<C-w><C-k>")
vim.keymap.set("n", "<C-l>", "<C-w><C-l>")

-- Configured plugin mappings
-- <Space> s f  Telescope: find files
-- <Space> s g  Telescope: live grep
-- <Space> a    Harpoon: remember a file
-- <Ctrl> e     Harpoon: quick menu
-- <Space> f    Conform: format buffer

files.name: hyprland.nix
files.description: A terminal, a browser, a launcher. A short path to the work.
files.code:
# Selected desktop bindings; variables are defined in the full config
bind = [
  "$mod, Return, exec, $term"
  "$mod, B, exec, $browser"
  "$mod, Space, exec, $menu"
  "$mod, O, exec, $files"
];

# Intel drives the desktop.
# Compatible GPU work uses explicit NVIDIA offload.
# Personal application state stays separate from Nix packages.

layers.title: Pinned source
layers.body: The flake names the inputs; the lock file fixes their revisions. Review a change before building it.

layers.title: NixOS
layers.body: System packages, services, login, networking and hardware integration. Intel drives the display; NVIDIA is explicitly offloaded.

layers.title: Home Manager
layers.body: User packages and configuration links are integrated with the system build. Credentials and application data have separate recovery needs.

layers.title: Neovim
layers.body: Nix supplies the editor and language tools. Telescope, Harpoon and Conform shorten the route from finding a file to checking a focused change.

layers.title: The daily workflow
layers.body: Kitty, Zsh, Rofi and project-specific commands connect the environment to actual code, tests and documented releases.
